cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron (glucocorticoid-responsive elements)
cases.mechanism_detail: The XDP-SVA in a TAF1 intron alters TAF1 transcription and splicing, reducing canonical TAF1 and producing the XDP-specific aberrant TAF1-32i transcript that incorporates intron 32 sequence; this study shows the SVA carries glucocorticoid receptor sites and has CORT-inducible promoter activity in reporter assays, studied in one patient fibroblast line.
cases.quote: X-linked Dystonia Parkinsonism (XDP) is associated with a SINE-VNTR- Alu (SVA) retrotransposon insertion in an intron of the TAF1 gene that alters gene transcription and splicing.
